essay.question: Bali (WADD) serves as a primary hub for a diverse mix of traffic, from international heavy jets (A380/B777) to domestic turboprops and VFR general aviation.
To the north of Ngurah Rai Airport, the terrain rises significantly toward Mount Agung and the central mountain range.
Bali is a popular destination for scenic VFR flights and helicopter transfers.
Modern Air Traffic Management in Indonesia increasingly relies on Performance-Based Navigation (PBN) and ADS-B surveillance.
